st_floor.check: A4a St is reported as a finite number on a series that is NaN
st_floor.mechanism: harmonic_amplitude() falls back to the frequency floor 1/T (0.001 lattice Hz) when the fit is degenerate -> St = f*D/u = 0.1 -> a finite -49.2% 'error' printed for a run whose Cd/Cl are NaN
st_floor.severity: minor-to-medium (reporting surface; a reader can take -49.2% as a measured error)
